name: Biofluid Mechanics
description: Fluid mechanics plays an important role in biology and bioengineering. Similarly, biology involves several interesting aspects of fluid mechanics and fluid-structure interaction, which can help engineers design biomimetic devices. In this introductory course, we will use well-established experimental data as well as mathematical analysis to model and understand fluid mechanics related to biological swimmers, birds, and human circulatory system.
